title: Arquiteto de soluções sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquiteto de soluções sênior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de identificar um(a) profissional capaz de compreender a fundo as necessidades do negócio e traduzi-las em soluções de arquitetura robustas, escaláveis e seguras, que agreguem valor à organização.


Compreensão e Análise de Negócio:

➢ Mapear os domínios funcionais relevantes para o negócio.

➢ Definir as capacidades de negócio que cada domínio habilita e como elas contribuem para a geração de valor.

➢ Identificar e detalhar os requisitos (funcionais, negócio, dados, conformidade, leis e regulatórios, etc.).

➢ Detalhamento dos requisitos não funcionais (desempenho, segurança, escalabilidade, etc.) e definição de métricas claras para cada um.

➢ Priorizar os requisitos com base no valor para o negócio e nas restrições técnicas.


Arquitetura e Design da Solução:

➢ Escolher padrões e estilos arquiteturais adequados (micros serviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).

➢ Explicar o motivo da escolha dos estilos e padrões arquiteturais, considerando os requisitos de negócio, as restrições técnicas e os trade-offs envolvidos.

➢ Considerar os trade-offs entre simplicidade e flexibilidade.

➢ Definir estratégias claras para lidar com o aumento da carga (escalabilidade).

➢ Implementar mecanismos de recuperação de falhas (resiliência).

➢ Atender aos requisitos de alta disponibilidade.

➢ Definir como os componentes se comunicam (protocolos, formatos de mensagem, etc).

➢ Escolher ferramentas e padrões de integração adequados e suas responsabilidades.

➢ Implementar autenticação, autorização e criptografia (segurança).

➢ Implementar mecanismos de proteção contra ataques (WAF, etc).

➢ Selecionar ferramentas e tecnologias adequadas para implementar a arquitetura, considerando aspectos como desempenho, custo, facilidade de uso e integração com outros sistemas.

➢ Justificar a escolha de cada ferramenta/tecnologia, demonstrando um entendimento de seus prós e contras.

➢ Demonstrar análise de impacto da solução proposta e em diferentes domínios (Dados, Segurança, Infraestrutura, Soluções e Software, etc.).

➢ Demonstrar a estimativa de custo da solução proposta.

Documentação e Apresentação:

➢ Documentar a arquitetura da solução de forma clara e concisa.

➢ Criar diagramas que representam a arquitetura da solução, incluindo os componentes, suas interações e os fluxos de dados.

➢ Centralizar documentações (Readme).

➢ Descrever possíveis melhorias ou expansões da solução.

➢ Demonstrar capacidade de visão e planejamento a longo prazo.

➢ Discutir trade-offs e desafios enfrentados durante o desenvolvimento.

Implementação e Operação:

➢ Definir métricas de monitoramento para acompanhar o desempenho, a disponibilidade e a segurança da solução.

➢ Implementar alertas para detectar problemas e responder rapidamente.

➢ Descrever ferramentas e técnicas para coletar, analisar e visualizar as métricas.


Requisitos Diferenciais:

➢ Definir os passos para migrar de um sistema de transição para a nova arquitetura (Arquitetura de Transição).

➢ Considerar os riscos e desafios da migração.

➢ Mapear os principais Riscos e Desafios identificados durante a proposta da solução.

➢ Descrever ações mitigatórias para os Riscos e possíveis soluções para os Desafios mapeados.

➢ Demonstrar conhecimento sobre as vantagens e desvantagens das tecnologias escolhidas.

➢ Demonstrar consciência dos tradeoffs envolvidos em cada decisão de arquitetura.

Requisitos e qualificações

Experiência:

➢ Experiência comprovada em projetos de arquitetura de soluções, com foco em integração de sistemas e otimização de processos.

➢ Experiência em análise de requisitos de negócios (funcionais e não funcionais) e transformação em soluções técnicas.

➢ Experiência com a definição e implementação de padrões arquiteturais (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).

➢ Vivência em ambientes de desenvolvimento ágil.


Conhecimentos Técnicos:

➢ Profundo conhecimento de padrões de integração de sistemas (APIs, mensageria, etc.).

➢ Sólido conhecimento de arquiteturas orientadas a micros serviços.

➢ Familiaridade com diferentes tecnologias e plataformas de desenvolvimento (ex: Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Cloud, etc.).

➢ Conhecimento de ferramentas de modelagem (ex: UML).

➢ Conhecimento de segurança da informação (autenticação, autorização, criptografia).

➢ Conhecimento de monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas.

➢ Familiaridade com ferramentas de versionamento de código (ex: Git).

➢ Conhecimento de estimativa de custos de infraestrutura e licenças.

Habilidades :

➢ Excelente capacidade de comunicação e negociação para influenciar stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.

➢ Visão sistêmica e capacidade de análise crítica para identificar oportunidades de melhoria em processos e sistemas.

➢ Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em especificações técnicas claras e concisas.

➢ Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas embasadas em dados e em um profundo entendimento dos trade-offs envolvidos.

➢ Habilidade de documentar soluções de forma clara e organizada.

➢ Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento.

Habilidades Comportamentais Desejáveis:

➢ Proatividade

➢ Pensamento analítico

➢ Orientação a resultados

➢ Colaboração

➢ Adaptabilidade

➢ Aprendizado contínuo

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Partner em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Partner (Active Sourcing)


Location: Fully Remote (Must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time



About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing consumer products company with more than 5 million customers using our products. Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. Uproot has also been featured across major television and media platforms, including QVC, Good Morning America, and Fox, helping introduce millions of consumers to the brand.

We care deeply about building products that genuinely solve problems for pet owners while operating with high standards across every part of the business. We are building a company focused on long-term excellence, creating significant opportunities for highly capable people who want real and meaningful impact, and the ability to help shape the future of the company.

About the Role

This is a hands-on execution role focused 100% on active sourcing. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach.

Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.



Responsibilities


Active Sourcing

  • Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels
  • Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent
  • Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Identify strong passive candidates
  • Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs.

Candidate Outreach

  • Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement
  • Qualify candidates early in the process
  • Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow

Pipeline Management

  • Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking
  • Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality
  • Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines
  • Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions
  • Generates strong response and assessment completion rates
  • Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight
  • Raises the overall talent bar of the company over time


Requirements

Must Have

  • 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory
  • Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms
  • Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills
  • Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques
  • Excellent written English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously

Strong Plus

  • Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads)

Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)


Who This Role Is For (& Not For)

This Role Is For You If:

  • You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does
  • You are naturally proactive and internally driven
  • You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards
  • You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability
  • You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work
  • You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You need constant direction or external motivation
  • You struggle with consistency and follow-through
  • You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates
  • You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination only

About YLD:

Our goal is to help our clients keep moving forward. We’re a team of curious, talented people, and we’re committed to making YLD a place where great people want to work, grow, and stay. About the role:

As a Forward Deployment Engineer at YLD, you'll be part of a client team building innovative products. We're looking for someone curious, passionate, driven, and enthusiastic. You should be skilled in problem-solving and experienced in designing scalable, resilient, and fault-tolerant architectures. You're also an effective communicator and a strong team player. Together with your team, you'll thrive in a fast-paced engineering environment, delivering outstanding results and exciting projects.


Your day-to-day responsibilities can look like this:

  • Design, build, and maintain robust backend and infrastructure systems using Golang and Java with contributions across the broader engineering stack
  • Work closely with client teams in collaborative working sessions, explaining technical decisions and translating complex engineering concepts clearly
  • Deploy and manage cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP using Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), Terraform , and Flux

You should apply if you are:

  • Pragmatic: you make sensible trade-offs and deliver results in ambiguous, fast-moving environments;

title: Senior Advanced Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Advanced Analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Toluna is the global research and insights leader that enables businesses to make smarter, data-driven decisions—faster. For 26 years, we have partnered with the world’s leading brands, delivering transformative impact through our advanced technology platform, comprehensive solution portfolio, expansive global first-party panel, and world-class team of leading research experts. Since 2019, we’ve made significant investments in artificial intelligence to enhance automation, accelerate insight delivery, and unlock deeper understanding at scale. With 40+ offices worldwide, Toluna operates in 70+ countries, redefining the future of insights. Learn


Introduction:

We are seeking a Senior Advanced Analyst to join our global Advanced Analytics team. In this role, you’ll lead the design and execution of advanced analytical solutions that inform strategic decision-making for our clients. You’ll leverage your deep technical expertise and market research experience to drive innovation, mentor junior analysts, and deliver impactful, data-driven recommendations.


This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate analytics professional who thrives at the intersection of data science, business strategy, and storytelling, with growing expectations around applied AI and intelligent automation.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and implementation of advanced analytical frameworks to address complex business challenges across a variety of industries.
  • Partner with internal teams and clients to translate business objectives into analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Design, build, and maintain practical analytics-facing AI-enabled solutions such as analytical agents, automated insights generation, or decision support tools using large language models or similar technologies.
  • Evaluate where AI can responsibly augment analytical work, including data preparation, model development, quality checks, insight synthesis, and delivery, while maintaining methodological rigor.
  • Partner with engineering, analytics, or product teams to operationalize AI-driven analytics in repeatable and scalable ways.
  • Deliver high-impact storytelling and visualization, distilling complex analyses into clear narratives that influence senior stakeholders.
  • Act as a trusted consultant, providing analytic guidance and thought leadership on market research methodologies, data interpretation, and advanced modeling.
  • Mentor and support junior analysts, reviewing outputs, sharing best practices, and fostering a culture of learning and quality.
  • Champion automation, standardization, and innovation, identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and analytical efficiency.
  • Stay current on emerging tools, data science techniques, and market trends to continuously enhance Toluna’s analytics capabilities.


Your profile:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data analytics, advanced analytics, or market research roles.
  • Bachelor’s or master's degree in data science, statistics, economics, computer science, or a related field.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python, R, SQL, SPSS and/or Sawtooth
  • Strong command of statistical modeling, segmentation, predictive analytics, and experimental design.
  • Proven ability to lead analytical projects from scoping to delivery, including stakeholder management and quality assurance.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, able to translate complex data findings into business implications.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI or machine learning in real-world analytics contexts, beyond academic or purely experimental work.
  • Familiarity with large language models and their practical use in analytics workflows, such as building or supervising AI agents, prompt-driven analysis, or automated insight generation.
  • Strong judgment around model quality, bias, explainability, and appropriate use of AI in client-facing analytical work.
  • Ability to clearly explain AI-driven approaches and limitations to non-technical stakeholders in plain business language.
  • Experience mentoring or leading junior analysts or cross-functional workstreams.
  • Must be fluent in English , with additional languages being a plus.


**Please submit your CV in English.


Our Values:

  • A cting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability
  • B ringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial
  • C ollaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness
  • D iscussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly
  • E mbracing empathy- Being egoless & caring


What we offer:

At Toluna, we’re all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you’re passionate about making an impact, we’d love to have you on board.


Other Benefits: Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, a meal voucher, a transportation voucher, and a language class subsidy.


Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You’ll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction.

title: Specialist AI Engineer / Builder (LLM & Healthcare) | Remote Job
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Specialist AI Engineer / Builder (LLM & Healthcare) | Remote Job em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Challenge

Every year, the healthcare industry loses billions due to billing failures. We are building the missing link that closes this gap with AI.

We are growing fast, with real operations, active customers, and new partners in the pipeline. We are looking for a builder who wants to help turn our current product into a platform with global scale.


Why This Role Might Be for You

Here, autonomy, ownership, and initiative are part of the daily routine. We are not looking for someone who already knows everything. Not knowing is part of the process. What matters to us is investigative curiosity, strong execution, and a genuine desire to learn.

You will work across both execution and strategy: from writing code to helping shape product and technical decisions. This is a role for someone who can propose new models, spot revenue opportunities, and also dig into data manually when needed to make sure the solution is truly accurate.

Speed, urgency, and attention to detail are essential to how we build.


Key Responsibilities

Your mission will be to help lead the evolution of our AI capabilities.

Today: Execution and Precision

  • Refine and optimize models already in production using AWS Bedrock, continuously improving accuracy and performance.
  • Validate data, rules, and outputs manually when needed. In healthcare, data quality is non-negotiable.
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement fast feedback loops so the system improves continuously.

Tomorrow: Scale and Architecture

  • Help evolve our infrastructure into a robust ecosystem using RAG pipelines and vector databases.
  • Move from a centralized AI solution toward a network of specialized models by context and insurance payer.
  • Contribute to fine-tuning proprietary models using our historical data to create a unique competitive advantage.


What We’re Looking For

  • Investigative curiosity: You want to understand complex medical billing rules and are motivated to master a difficult domain. Healthcare experience is not required.
  • Bias for action: You move fast, take initiative, and understand that speed matters in an early-stage company.
  • Hands-on coding ability: Solid practical experience with Python or Go, plus experience working with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or AWS Bedrock.
  • Builder mindset: You enjoy creating robust systems from scratch and care deeply about precision, reliability, and business impact.


What We Offer

  • Early-stage impact: Be one of the early team members in a fast-growing company and help shape both the architecture and the culture.
  • High-level technical challenge: Work on real business problems using modern generative AI.
  • Strong team: Work with ambitious, high-performing people who care about building something meaningful.
  • Remote flexibility: 100% remote work, open to candidates based in Brazil.
  • Long-term upside: Potential equity participation for people who help build the business with us.
  • Legacy: Your work will leave a real mark on the product, the codebase, and the company’s story.

title: Designer Gráfico  (Foco em Social Media & Motion)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Designer Gráfico (Foco em Social Media & Motion) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Vaga: Designer Gráfico (Foco em Social Media & Motion - PJ)


Pacote de remuneração:

  • R$ 3.000,00/mês
  • Previdência Privada (opcional)
  • Férias Remuneradas
  • Modelo: Remoto


Como se candidatar: Envie seu currículo e portfólio atualizado para


Sobre a Posição


Buscamos um Designer Gráfico criativo e antenado para integrar nosso time. O foco principal será criação de KVs e desdobramento de peças para canais online e a criação de conteúdos dinâmicos (motion design). Se você tem um olhar estético apurado, domina as ferramentas de edição e gosta de transformar estática em movimento, essa vaga é para você.


Responsabilidades


  • Desdobramento de Peças: Adaptar identidades visuais para diversos formatos de redes sociais (Feed, Stories, Reels, Carrosséis).
  • Criação em Motion: Desenvolver posts animados e elementos em motion design para elevar o nível de engajamento das marcas.
  • Comunicação Visual: Desenvolver peças gráficas para canais digitais (banners, e-mail marketing, apresentações) e eventuais materiais offline.
  • Colaboração Criativa: Participar de briefings para sugerir soluções visuais que sigam as tendências atuais.


Requisitos


  • Formação concluída ou em fase final em Design Gráfico, Publicidade ou áreas correlatas.
  • Domínio do Pacote Adobe/Figma: Photoshop e Illustrator são essenciais.
  • Motion Design: Conhecimento em After Effects ou ferramentas similares para animação de posts.
  • Portfólio que demonstre habilidades em composição, tipografia e ritmo de vídeo.
  • Capacidade de produção independente e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Organização para lidar com volume de entregas e prazos.


Diferenciais


  • Trends: Estar por dentro das linguagens e estéticas do TikTok/Reels.
  • Experiência prévia no mercado de seguros ou tecnologia.


Por que trabalhar com a Segbox?


Valorizamos a autonomia e a flexibilidade. Acreditamos em um equilíbrio saudável entre vida profissional e pessoal. Aqui, suas ideias têm voz e sua criatividade é o motor que ajuda a transformar o mercado de seguros.


Sobre a Segbox


  • A Segbox é uma empresa de tecnologia e inovação para o mercado de seguros. Fazemos parte da maior assessoria de seguros do país e somos responsáveis pela presença digital de diversas contas e sites do segmento.

A AI/R Everymind , fundada em novembro de 2014, é parceira oficial da Salesforce desde 2015 e especialista multicloud. Desenvolvemos soluções que transformam negócios de todos os portes e setores, unindo visão 360°, expertise tecnológica e uma mentalidade de inovação pioneira.

  • Organização para gerenciar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente .
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração com áreas técnicas e de negócio.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Partner em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Partner (Active Sourcing)


Location: Fully Remote (Must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time



About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing consumer products company with more than 5 million customers using our products. Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. Uproot has also been featured across major television and media platforms, including QVC, Good Morning America, and Fox, helping introduce millions of consumers to the brand.

We care deeply about building products that genuinely solve problems for pet owners while operating with high standards across every part of the business. We are building a company focused on long-term excellence, creating significant opportunities for highly capable people who want real and meaningful impact, and the ability to help shape the future of the company.

About the Role

This is a hands-on execution role focused 100% on active sourcing. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach.

Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.



Responsibilities


Active Sourcing

  • Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels
  • Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent
  • Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Identify strong passive candidates
  • Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs.

Candidate Outreach

  • Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement
  • Qualify candidates early in the process
  • Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow

Pipeline Management

  • Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking
  • Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality
  • Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines
  • Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions
  • Generates strong response and assessment completion rates
  • Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight
  • Raises the overall talent bar of the company over time


Requirements

Must Have

  • 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory
  • Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms
  • Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills
  • Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques
  • Excellent written English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously

Strong Plus

  • Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads)

Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)


Who This Role Is For (& Not For)

This Role Is For You If:

  • You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does
  • You are naturally proactive and internally driven
  • You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards
  • You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability
  • You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work
  • You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You need constant direction or external motivation
  • You struggle with consistency and follow-through
  • You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates
  • You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination only


Compensation & Benefits

Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience.

  • Salary : Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure
  • Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company’s growth and direction
  • Fully remote : work from anywhere
  • PTO : 2 Weeks
  • Flex Day : An additional quarterly day off dedicated to rest and recovery
  • Thinking Day: one dedicated day each quarter to step away from day-to-day execution and think deeply about your role, systems, ideas, and long-term impact
  • Wellness Reimbursement: $100-$300/month, based on location, to help support your wellness.
  • Pet Reimbursement: $40-100/month, based on location to help support parenting a pet.
  • Coaching credits: $1,000+/year for coaching, education, and professional development


Ready to Apply?

If you are excited by high standards, proactive recruiting, and the challenge of building world-class talent pipelines, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Tech Lead ReactJS
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Tech Lead ReactJS em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

(Tech Lead React)

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Atuar como referência técnica em frontend, liderando a construção e evolução de soluções digitais com foco em performance, escalabilidade e experiência do usuário.   • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento (Git).

  • Experiência em integração de APIs RESTful e práticas de DevOps/CI-CD.

title: Business Intelligence Developer (remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Intelligence Developer (remote) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Brunel está apoiando uma consultoria de dados na busca por um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de BI Pleno para atuar na construção e evolução de soluções analíticas, com forte ênfase em engenharia de dados.

A atuação envolve contato frequente com interlocutores internacionais , por isso o inglês é essencial para o dia a dia (reuniões, alinhamentos e documentação).

O dia a dia inclui desde a modelagem e transformação de dados até a entrega de dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão. A pessoa ideal combina domínio técnico em ferramentas de BI com sólida experiência em SQL e scripting para manipulação de dados em escala.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e soluções analíticas em Power BI ou Qlik (Sense/SaaS) .
  • Escrever e otimizar queries complexas em SQL para extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT).
  • Modelar dados dimensionais e relacionais, garantindo performance e escalabilidade das soluções.

About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Arquiteto de soluções sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquiteto de soluções sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de identificar um(a) profissional capaz de compreender a fundo as necessidades do negócio e traduzi-las em soluções de arquitetura robustas, escaláveis e seguras, que agreguem valor à organização.


Compreensão e Análise de Negócio:

➢ Mapear os domínios funcionais relevantes para o negócio.

➢ Definir as capacidades de negócio que cada domínio habilita e como elas contribuem para a geração de valor.

➢ Identificar e detalhar os requisitos (funcionais, negócio, dados, conformidade, leis e regulatórios, etc.).

➢ Detalhamento dos requisitos não funcionais (desempenho, segurança, escalabilidade, etc.) e definição de métricas claras para cada um.

➢ Priorizar os requisitos com base no valor para o negócio e nas restrições técnicas.


Arquitetura e Design da Solução:

➢ Escolher padrões e estilos arquiteturais adequados (micros serviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).

➢ Explicar o motivo da escolha dos estilos e padrões arquiteturais, considerando os requisitos de negócio, as restrições técnicas e os trade-offs envolvidos.

➢ Considerar os trade-offs entre simplicidade e flexibilidade.

➢ Definir estratégias claras para lidar com o aumento da carga (escalabilidade).

➢ Implementar mecanismos de recuperação de falhas (resiliência).

➢ Atender aos requisitos de alta disponibilidade.

➢ Definir como os componentes se comunicam (protocolos, formatos de mensagem, etc).

➢ Escolher ferramentas e padrões de integração adequados e suas responsabilidades.

➢ Implementar autenticação, autorização e criptografia (segurança).

➢ Implementar mecanismos de proteção contra ataques (WAF, etc).

➢ Selecionar ferramentas e tecnologias adequadas para implementar a arquitetura, considerando aspectos como desempenho, custo, facilidade de uso e integração com outros sistemas.

➢ Justificar a escolha de cada ferramenta/tecnologia, demonstrando um entendimento de seus prós e contras.

➢ Demonstrar análise de impacto da solução proposta e em diferentes domínios (Dados, Segurança, Infraestrutura, Soluções e Software, etc.).

➢ Demonstrar a estimativa de custo da solução proposta.

Documentação e Apresentação:

➢ Documentar a arquitetura da solução de forma clara e concisa.

➢ Criar diagramas que representam a arquitetura da solução, incluindo os componentes, suas interações e os fluxos de dados.

➢ Centralizar documentações (Readme).

➢ Descrever possíveis melhorias ou expansões da solução.

➢ Demonstrar capacidade de visão e planejamento a longo prazo.

➢ Discutir trade-offs e desafios enfrentados durante o desenvolvimento.

Implementação e Operação:

➢ Definir métricas de monitoramento para acompanhar o desempenho, a disponibilidade e a segurança da solução.

➢ Implementar alertas para detectar problemas e responder rapidamente.

➢ Descrever ferramentas e técnicas para coletar, analisar e visualizar as métricas.


Requisitos Diferenciais:

➢ Definir os passos para migrar de um sistema de transição para a nova arquitetura (Arquitetura de Transição).

➢ Considerar os riscos e desafios da migração.

➢ Mapear os principais Riscos e Desafios identificados durante a proposta da solução.

➢ Descrever ações mitigatórias para os Riscos e possíveis soluções para os Desafios mapeados.

➢ Demonstrar conhecimento sobre as vantagens e desvantagens das tecnologias escolhidas.

➢ Demonstrar consciência dos tradeoffs envolvidos em cada decisão de arquitetura.

Requisitos e qualificações

Experiência:

➢ Experiência comprovada em projetos de arquitetura de soluções, com foco em integração de sistemas e otimização de processos.

➢ Experiência em análise de requisitos de negócios (funcionais e não funcionais) e transformação em soluções técnicas.

➢ Experiência com a definição e implementação de padrões arquiteturais (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).

➢ Vivência em ambientes de desenvolvimento ágil.


Conhecimentos Técnicos:

➢ Profundo conhecimento de padrões de integração de sistemas (APIs, mensageria, etc.).

➢ Sólido conhecimento de arquiteturas orientadas a micros serviços.

➢ Familiaridade com diferentes tecnologias e plataformas de desenvolvimento (ex: Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Cloud, etc.).

➢ Conhecimento de ferramentas de modelagem (ex: UML).

➢ Conhecimento de segurança da informação (autenticação, autorização, criptografia).

➢ Conhecimento de monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas.

➢ Familiaridade com ferramentas de versionamento de código (ex: Git).

➢ Conhecimento de estimativa de custos de infraestrutura e licenças.

Habilidades :

➢ Excelente capacidade de comunicação e negociação para influenciar stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.

➢ Visão sistêmica e capacidade de análise crítica para identificar oportunidades de melhoria em processos e sistemas.

➢ Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em especificações técnicas claras e concisas.

title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Product Designer (UX/UI) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required for evaluation ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

About YLD:

Our goal is to help our clients keep moving forward. We work with them to build the skills and capabilities they need to stay ahead of the competition, and we know our success only happens when they succeed. We’re a team of curious, talented people, and we’re committed to making YLD a place where great people want to work, grow, and stay. We’re a remote-first consultancy specialising in software engineering, product design, and data. Our teams are based across London, Lisbon, and Porto, and we create digital solutions that continue to deliver value long after our work is done.


About the role:

As a Forward Deployment Engineer at YLD, you'll be part of a client team building innovative products. We're looking for someone curious, passionate, driven, and enthusiastic. You should be skilled in problem-solving and experienced in designing scalable, resilient, and fault-tolerant architectures. You're also an effective communicator and a strong team player. Together with your team, you'll thrive in a fast-paced engineering environment, delivering outstanding results and exciting projects.


Your day-to-day responsibilities can look like this:

  • Design, build, and maintain robust backend and infrastructure systems using Golang and Java with contributions across the broader engineering stack
  • Work closely with client teams in collaborative working sessions, explaining technical decisions and translating complex engineering concepts clearly
  • Deploy and manage cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP using Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), Terraform , and Flux
  • Actively leverage AI-powered tools and workflows to accelerate development, improve code quality, and drive engineering best practices


Preferred skills:

  • Strong backend and infrastructure engineering background, with hands-on Golang and Java experience;
  • Experience developing or integrating decentralised systems, data infrastructure, or distributed technologies;
  • Solid command of cloud infrastructure: AWS , GCP , Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), Terraform , and Flux ;
  • Actively and meaningfully using AI tools in day-to-day coding practice (not just awareness, but advanced, habitual use);
  • Familiarity with TigerBeetle, YugabyteDB, or Red Panda;
  • Experience in fintech, core banking, or regulated financial services environments;
  • Open to occasional travel to London.


You should apply if you are:

  • Proactive: You take ownership and move things forward without waiting to be asked;
  • A strong communicator: you express technical ideas clearly, in writing and in client-facing conversations, with full professional fluency in English;
  • Confident presenting: you bring a polished, engaged attitude to working sessions and stakeholder interactions;
  • Focused on quality: you care about doing things properly and hold yourself to a high standard;
  • Pragmatic: you make sensible trade-offs and deliver results in ambiguous, fast-moving environments;
  • A creative problem solver: you approach hard engineering challenges with curiosity and ingenuity;
  • Collaborative: you thrive on working within cross-functional, distributed teams and value others' input.


What you’ll get in return:

  • The chance to work with a forward-thinking, ethical, and fun group of people and to develop and grow your skills in a fast-moving business

  • 1st Interview with someone from the Talent team (30/45 mins)
  • Technical Interview with our Senior Developers (1h30)
  • Final chat with our Client Partner (30/45 mins)

title: Business Intelligence Developer (remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Intelligence Developer (remote) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Brunel está apoiando uma consultoria de dados na busca por um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de BI Pleno para atuar na construção e evolução de soluções analíticas, com forte ênfase em engenharia de dados.

A atuação envolve contato frequente com interlocutores internacionais , por isso o inglês é essencial para o dia a dia (reuniões, alinhamentos e documentação).

O dia a dia inclui desde a modelagem e transformação de dados até a entrega de dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão. A pessoa ideal combina domínio técnico em ferramentas de BI com sólida experiência em SQL e scripting para manipulação de dados em escala.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e soluções analíticas em Power BI ou Qlik (Sense/SaaS) .
  • Escrever e otimizar queries complexas em SQL para extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT).
  • Modelar dados dimensionais e relacionais, garantindo performance e escalabilidade das soluções.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando scripts em SQL, Python ou outras linguagens pertinentes.
  • Conectar e integrar múltiplas fontes de dados (bancos relacionais, APIs, arquivos flat, data lakes).
  • Documentar processos, modelos de dados e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (produto, engenharia, negócios) para traduzir necessidades em soluções de dados.
  • Participar de code reviews e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada (3+ anos) com desenvolvimento de BI e/ou engenharia de dados.
  • Domínio avançado de SQL (CTEs, window functions, otimização de queries, stored procedures).
  • Experiência prática com Power BI (DAX, Power Query/M) e/ou Qlik (script de carga, set analysis).
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados (star schema, snowflake, Data Vault).

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Emerging Market Trader em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African/LATAM/Asian currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS), LATAM (ARS, BRL, MXN) and/or Asian (IDR, VDN, etc.) on markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives.


You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Designer de Apresentações (Pleno/Sênior) - Banco de talentos em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O que buscamos:

Estamos em busca de um Designer de Apresentações com forte experiência em criação de layouts, templates e narrativas visuais, capaz de seguir guidelines de marca com excelência estética e transformar conteúdos complexos, incluindo materiais médicos e científicos, em apresentações claras, estratégicas e visualmente atraentes. Procuramos um profissional com domínio de Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, olhar apurado para hierarquia visual, acessibilidade e storytelling, habilidade para resolver problemas de design com agilidade e interesse constante por novas tendências e ferramentas inovadoras.

Inglês fluente é mandatório pois trabalhamos em projetos internacionais com times globais.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver apresentações estratégicas, dinâmicas e visualmente sofisticadas, garantindo consistência com as diretrizes de marca, excelência estética e adaptação para diferentes formatos e dispositivos (desktop, tablet e mobile);
  • Atuar em reuniões de briefing e colaborar diretamente com stakeholders para transformar informações complexas em storytelling claros, objetivos e visualmente impactantes;
  • Trabalhar com materiais médicos e científicos, assegurando alto nível de precisão, atenção a detalhes e tratamento adequado de dados, além de transformar conteúdos técnicos e densos em apresentações visualmente atraentes, organizadas e de fácil compreensão;
  • Gerenciar o processo de desenvolvimento de apresentações do início ao fim, incluindo alinhamento com stakeholders, construção da narrativa, criação de layouts, incorporação de feedbacks e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Ser responsável pela revisão final e controle de qualidade das apresentações antes do compartilhamento, assegurando clareza, consistência visual e precisão das informações;
  • Trabalhar de forma independente ou colaborativa com outros designers, gerenciando múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e mantendo alta performance em ambientes de ritmo acelerado.


Requerimentos & Skills:

  • Experiência mínima de 4 anos em Design de Apresentações, com formação superior (bacharelado) em Design, Artes Visuais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio avançado de ferramentas de apresentação, incluindo PowerPoint, Google Slides, Keynote e Prezi, além de proficiência em ferramentas essenciais do dia a dia, como Word e Excel, para organização, edição e estruturação de conteúdos e dados
  • Possuir conhecimento sólido em Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, sendo capaz de transformar dados complexos em gráficos, dashboards, mapas e infográficos claros, estratégicos e visualmente atraentes. Espera-se domínio de hierarquia visual, organização da informação, escolha adequada de visualizações, simplificação de conteúdos densos e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma intuitiva para diferentes públicos.
  • Conhecimento em animação e construção de apresentações interativas, utilizando transições e motion design para criar narrativas visuais fluidas, dinâmicas e envolventes
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de design e edição visual, como Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator e InDesign) e/ou Figma, para criação e refinamento de assets gráficos, layouts e materiais de apoio
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de inteligência artificial (IA) aplicadas à automação e otimização de processos criativos, como Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Claude, Gamma, Adobe Firefly e recursos de IA integrados ao Photoshop
  • Forte repertório em design gráfico, com domínio de tipografia, teoria das cores, hierarquia visual, contraste, grids/alinhamentos e princípios de composição, além de olhar apurado para criar materiais limpos, sofisticados e profissionais;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, colaboração e gerenciamento de projetos, com capacidade para atuar em múltiplas demandas simultaneamente;
  • Inglês avançado/fluente.


Está preparado(a) para cultivar novas experiências em um time que joga junto e valoriza o melhor de cada um(a)?

title: Assistant Production Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Assistant Production Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Headshots.com


At Headshots.com, we’re reimagining how professional headshots are created and delivered. Trusted by clients like Boeing, Capital One, and American Express, we transform smartphone selfies into polished, studio-quality portraits within three business days. Our work helps individuals and teams present themselves with consistency and confidence across digital platforms.


We’re looking for an Assistant Production Manager, reporting to the Production Manager, who will co-lead our photo editing and quality control teams, guide strategy and drive operational excellence.


About the Role


This role combines production oversight with a deep appreciation for the artistry of headshot retouching. You’ll manage the daily operations of our editing team, ensuring that each image reflects the clarity, subtlety, and professionalism our brand is known for.


We're seeking someone who brings both technical expertise and a discerning creative eye—someone who can guide a team to produce beautiful, natural edits that elevate the subject rather than over-process them.


Key Responsibilities


Production & Quality Control

  • Co-develop strategic initiatives to strengthen and improve production operations
  • Ensure timely reporting and clear communication across production workflows
  • Oversee daily editing operations to support consistent, high-quality delivery of headshots
  • Maintain quality standards across visual consistency, lighting, natural retouching, and overall image polish
  • Identify recurring issues, provide constructive feedback, and support continuous improvement across the production team
  • Step in as needed to assist with editing, troubleshooting, or complex production requests


Team Leadership & Coaching

  • Supervise and mentor a team of photo editors
  • Hire, train, and onboard new editors to uphold brand standards
  • Foster a collaborative, high-accountability culture with clear communication


Workflow Management & Operational Oversight

  • Monitor task queues and deadlines to ensure smooth project flow
  • Optimize systems and tools to eliminate inefficiencies or bottlenecks
  • Lead team meetings, track KPIs, and document standard operating procedures


Client & Project Coordination

  • Collaborate across internal teams to meet client-specific requirements
  • Maintain a client-centered approach while balancing quality and turnaround
  • Support the development of background templates, sample images, and visual assets as needed


What You Bring


Experience & Skills

  • 6+ years of photo retouching experience, especially in headshots or portraits
  • 3+ years managing creative or production teams
  • Experience with tools like Dropbox, Asana, and Slack
  • Strong organizational and communication skills


Mindset & Strengths

  • Excellent attention to detail and visual aesthetics
  • A \"no-ego\" team player: You leave your ego at the door, take extreme ownership of your work, and build deep trust through transparent communication.
  • Reliable, deadline-driven, and calm under pressure
  • Creative problem-solver with a passion for helping people look their best
  • Comfortable giving and receiving feedback in a collaborative team environment


Why Join Us?

  • Flexible, remote work
  • Work with a high-performing creative team
  • Opportunity to shape the quality and scale of a fast-growing brand


Compensation: $16-18/hour (full-time contract) depending on experience

Schedule: Monday to Friday | Flexible hours (ET hours)


IMPORTANT:

Direct inquiries will disqualify candidates.

title: K-POP Influencers
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para K-POP Influencers em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. K-POP & K-DRAMA Influencer Growth CreatorPowered by IZISURFAbout IZISURF

IZISURF is building a next-generation creator growth ecosystem focused on K-POP, K-Drama, Korean entertainment, and global fan communities. Our mission is to help passionate creators transform their content into scalable global media brands through audience growth, AI-powered optimization, fan engagement strategies, and cross-platform expansion.

We believe that the future of entertainment media belongs to creators who deeply understand fandom culture, digital storytelling, and internet trends. As Korean entertainment continues to influence global culture, we are creating an infrastructure that helps influencers grow faster, engage audiences more effectively, and unlock meaningful monetization opportunities.

Unlike traditional influencer agencies, IZISURF operates as a creator growth partner. We actively work alongside creators to optimize content performance, identify viral opportunities, improve audience retention, and expand creator reach across multiple social media platforms. Our goal is not only to help creators gain followers, but to help them build long-term digital brands with sustainable growth.

Position Overview

We are looking for highly creative, trend-aware, and passionate K-POP & K-Drama Influencer Growth Creators who are excited about Korean entertainment culture and want to build a strong global online presence.

This role is ideal for individuals who genuinely enjoy discussing K-POP groups, idols, dramas, entertainment news, fan theories, comeback analysis, performances, concerts, and online fandom culture. Whether you are already an influencer or an emerging creator with strong potential, we are interested in working with people who can create authentic and engaging content that resonates with audiences worldwide.

As part of IZISURF, creators will receive strategic support designed to accelerate growth. Our team helps creators improve audience engagement, optimize content formats, analyze performance metrics, and identify viral content opportunities. We work collaboratively with creators to develop sustainable content strategies rather than focusing only on short-term trends.

Responsibilities

The selected creator will regularly produce engaging content related to K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, entertainment culture, idol trends, music releases, and fan discussions. Content may include reactions, commentary, reviews, rankings, livestream discussions, entertainment analysis, short-form videos, and community engagement activities.

Creators will publish content across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, YouTube, X (Twitter), Threads, and other emerging media channels. The role requires staying highly informed about ongoing entertainment trends, comeback schedules, drama releases, viral online discussions, and fandom activities.

In addition to content production, creators will collaborate closely with the IZISURF growth team to improve visibility and engagement. This includes reviewing analytics, refining content strategy, experimenting with new content formats, and participating in cross-platform growth campaigns. We encourage creators to continuously evolve their personal brand while maintaining authenticity and strong audience connection.

Creators may also participate in brand collaborations, entertainment campaigns, livestream events, fan engagement projects, and promotional activities related to Korean entertainment and digital culture.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

At IZISURF, we do not simply recruit influencers — we actively help creators grow.

Our team provides strategic support in audience development, content optimization, social media analytics, trend intelligence, and creator branding. We help creators identify what content performs best, how to improve audience retention, and how to scale engagement across multiple platforms.

Creators working with IZISURF may gain access to growth resources, collaboration opportunities, creator partnerships, AI-assisted content workflows, monetization strategies, and entertainment-related campaigns designed to increase visibility and accelerate growth.

We believe that many talented creators struggle not because of creativity, but because they lack access to proper growth infrastructure. IZISURF is designed to solve that problem by combining entertainment culture expertise with modern digital growth systems.

Preferred Qualifications

We are looking for individuals who are highly passionate about Korean entertainment culture and actively follow K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, and fandom communities. Strong communication skills, creativity, consistency, and comfort appearing on camera are highly valuable for this role.

Experience with social media content creation is preferred, but we are also open to emerging creators who demonstrate strong potential, personality, and storytelling ability. Familiarity with short-form video platforms, editing tools, and internet culture trends is important.

Candidates who already maintain active social media accounts, fan communities, or entertainment-focused content channels are strongly encouraged to apply. Korean language skills are a plus but are not required.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys talking about Korean entertainment and naturally engages with online communities. You are someone who understands internet culture, stays updated on trends, and enjoys creating content that sparks discussion and engagement.

You are creative, ambitious, and interested in building a long-term digital presence rather than simply posting occasional entertainment updates. You are excited about growing alongside a team that actively supports creator development and digital brand expansion.

Most importantly, you understand fandom culture and can create content that feels authentic, relatable, and engaging to global audiences.

title: Desenvolvedor React/Next Pleno
description:

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor React/Next Pleno para atuar no desenvolvimento e na evolução de interfaces web modernas e escaláveis. O papel exige sólida experiência no ecossistema React e Next.js, com foco na implementação de layouts responsivos, acessíveis e de alta performance utilizando SSR, SSG e ISR. O escopo técnico envolve a criação de componentes reutilizáveis integrados a design systems, o consumo de APIs REST e a garantia da qualidade de código através de testes com Jest e Testing Library. O profissional atuará em um ambiente colaborativo e ágil, lidando com conceitos de micro-frontends, otimizações de SEO e fluxos de CI/CD para deploy em nuvem.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir interfaces web utilizando React, Next.js e testes com Jest.
  • Implementar layouts responsivos e acessíveis, garantindo uma excelente experiência do usuário.
  • Consumir e integrar APIs REST no frontend.
  • Traduzir requisitos funcionais e de negócio em soluções técnicas eficientes.
  • Garantir a qualidade de código, performance e aplicação de boas práticas de frontend.
  • Criar e manter componentes reutilizáveis dentro do ecossistema do projeto.
  • Atuar na correção de bugs e em melhorias contínuas das aplicações.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times multidisciplinares de Backend, QA e Produto.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis (planning, dailies, reviews e retros).
  • Contribuir para a evolução da arquitetura frontend e dos padrões do projeto.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência comprovada de 3+ anos em desenvolvimento frontend.
  • Conhecimento sólido em React, Next.js (incluindo SSR, SSG e ISR) e testes com Jest.
  • Experiência prática com JavaScript (ES6+) e/ou TypeScript.
  • Sólido conhecimento em HTML5, CSS3, conceitos de responsividade e ferramentas de estilização (Styled Components, Tailwind ou CSS Modules).

Compreensão e Análise de Negócio:

➢ Mapear os domínios funcionais relevantes para o negócio.

➢ Definir as capacidades de negócio que cada domínio habilita e como elas contribuem para a geração de valor.

➢ Identificar e detalhar os requisitos (funcionais, negócio, dados, conformidade, leis e regulatórios, etc.).

➢ Detalhamento dos requisitos não funcionais (desempenho, segurança, escalabilidade, etc.) e definição de métricas claras para cada um.

➢ Priorizar os requisitos com base no valor para o negócio e nas restrições técnicas.


Arquitetura e Design da Solução:

➢ Escolher padrões e estilos arquiteturais adequados (micros serviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).

➢ Explicar o motivo da escolha dos estilos e padrões arquiteturais, considerando os requisitos de negócio, as restrições técnicas e os trade-offs envolvidos.

➢ Considerar os trade-offs entre simplicidade e flexibilidade.

➢ Definir estratégias claras para lidar com o aumento da carga (escalabilidade).

➢ Implementar mecanismos de recuperação de falhas (resiliência).

➢ Atender aos requisitos de alta disponibilidade.

➢ Definir como os componentes se comunicam (protocolos, formatos de mensagem, etc).

➢ Escolher ferramentas e padrões de integração adequados e suas responsabilidades.

➢ Implementar autenticação, autorização e criptografia (segurança).

➢ Implementar mecanismos de proteção contra ataques (WAF, etc).

➢ Selecionar ferramentas e tecnologias adequadas para implementar a arquitetura, considerando aspectos como desempenho, custo, facilidade de uso e integração com outros sistemas.

➢ Justificar a escolha de cada ferramenta/tecnologia, demonstrando um entendimento de seus prós e contras.

➢ Demonstrar análise de impacto da solução proposta e em diferentes domínios (Dados, Segurança, Infraestrutura, Soluções e Software, etc.).

➢ Demonstrar a estimativa de custo da solução proposta.

Documentação e Apresentação:

➢ Documentar a arquitetura da solução de forma clara e concisa.

➢ Criar diagramas que representam a arquitetura da solução, incluindo os componentes, suas interações e os fluxos de dados.

➢ Centralizar documentações (Readme).

➢ Descrever possíveis melhorias ou expansões da solução.

➢ Demonstrar capacidade de visão e planejamento a longo prazo.

➢ Discutir trade-offs e desafios enfrentados durante o desenvolvimento.

Implementação e Operação:

➢ Definir métricas de monitoramento para acompanhar o desempenho, a disponibilidade e a segurança da solução.

➢ Implementar alertas para detectar problemas e responder rapidamente.

➢ Descrever ferramentas e técnicas para coletar, analisar e visualizar as métricas.


Requisitos Diferenciais:

➢ Definir os passos para migrar de um sistema de transição para a nova arquitetura (Arquitetura de Transição).

➢ Considerar os riscos e desafios da migração.

➢ Mapear os principais Riscos e Desafios identificados durante a proposta da solução.

➢ Descrever ações mitigatórias para os Riscos e possíveis soluções para os Desafios mapeados.

➢ Demonstrar conhecimento sobre as vantagens e desvantagens das tecnologias escolhidas.

➢ Demonstrar consciência dos tradeoffs envolvidos em cada decisão de arquitetura.

Requisitos e qualificações

Experiência:

➢ Experiência comprovada em projetos de arquitetura de soluções, com foco em integração de sistemas e otimização de processos.

➢ Experiência em análise de requisitos de negócios (funcionais e não funcionais) e transformação em soluções técnicas.

➢ Experiência com a definição e implementação de padrões arquiteturais (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).

➢ Vivência em ambientes de desenvolvimento ágil.


Conhecimentos Técnicos:

➢ Profundo conhecimento de padrões de integração de sistemas (APIs, mensageria, etc.).

➢ Sólido conhecimento de arquiteturas orientadas a micros serviços.

➢ Familiaridade com diferentes tecnologias e plataformas de desenvolvimento (ex: Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Cloud, etc.).

➢ Conhecimento de ferramentas de modelagem (ex: UML).

➢ Conhecimento de segurança da informação (autenticação, autorização, criptografia).

➢ Conhecimento de monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas.

➢ Familiaridade com ferramentas de versionamento de código (ex: Git).

➢ Conhecimento de estimativa de custos de infraestrutura e licenças.

Habilidades :

➢ Excelente capacidade de comunicação e negociação para influenciar stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.

➢ Visão sistêmica e capacidade de análise crítica para identificar oportunidades de melhoria em processos e sistemas.

➢ Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em especificações técnicas claras e concisas.

➢ Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas embasadas em dados e em um profundo entendimento dos trade-offs envolvidos.

➢ Habilidade de documentar soluções de forma clara e organizada.

➢ Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento.

Habilidades Comportamentais Desejáveis:

➢ Proatividade

➢ Pensamento analítico

➢ Orientação a resultados

➢ Colaboração

➢ Adaptabilidade

➢ Aprendizado contínuo
